title: Aria2c allows unauthorized websocket connections
evidence: DEFECT: createJsonRpcErrorResponse() hard-coded RpcResponse::AUTHORIZED, so any malformed WS message (parse error, non-object, empty batch, control frame) marked the session authorized and it then received all onDownload* notifications. Rewritten: error responses report NOTAUTHORIZED; new all_authorized() requires a non-empty batch. RED proven: pre-fix e2e showed the attacker session receiving onDownloadStart with the GID.

title: Retry when connections got 503
evidence: DEFECT (intended-but-unbounded): a 503 retry resets the try count on wake to avoid consuming the permanent budget, so a permanently-503 server retried forever. RED proven: pre-fix e2e never left active/waiting (timeout).
